name: Metatarsus Adductus
definition: Medial deviation of the forefoot relative to the hindfoot in infants, ranging from flexible positional deformity to rigid structural adduction.

investigations.principle: Imaging is usually unnecessary in flexible infant cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Serial casting for selected rigid deformities
amber: Persistent rigid deformity may require specialist treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-vikriti phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Medial deviation of the forefoot relative to the hindfoot in infants, ranging from flexible positional deformity to rigid structural adduction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
